messages:
marta: Pushing a config-only canary now (18:45 UTC). Small param changes: rate_limit 120rps -> 100rps, request_timeout 3s -> 2.5s, route policy updated to prefer dc-us-east for premium tenants, batch_window 12ms -> 8ms. No model/code changes. Tag cfg/v2.4.3

deploy-bot: @marta triggered deploy: service=inference runtime=config-only target=canary shard=us-east-1 change=catalog:rate_limit,timeout,routing,batching

alex: questions: are we pinning model variants on this canary? want to avoid falling back to larger models if routing hiccups

marta: good call. pinning model-version=redwood-1.2.0 for canary and first 10% traffic. will enable fallback to small-variant only after manual approval

jia: monitoring checklist? thresholds to auto-roll back?

marta: baseline: error_rate < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < +30ms
rollback triggers:
- error_rate > 1% sustained for 3m
- p95 latency increase > +120ms for 5m
- downstream 5xx spike (>0.5% absolute)

samir: I'll be oncall during the window (18:40-20:30). I'll watch SLO dashboards and latency traces. ping me in this thread if anything.

ops-bot: Added incident watch: dashboard=inference-canary, alerts=[error_rate,latency,p50,p95] owner=samir

marta: rollback playbook (short):
```
# rollback if thresholds hit
deploy-bot rollback --service inference --tag cfg/v2.4.3 --to-tag cfg/v2.4.2
# pin traffic back to stable
k8s apply -f routing/restore-stable.yaml
# notify
post-message --channel=eng-releases --text="Rolling back cfg/v2.4.3 canary due to thresholds"
```

alex: also please add a short note for release notes: explain reason for lowering rate_limit and batch_window; mention no model changes

marta: will add release-note snippet after canary looks good. plan: 30m observation, then 10%->50% ramp if healthy. rollforward schedule in comments.

jia: adding synthetic smoke tests to verify priority-tenant routing and KV cache behavior.

marta: thanks all. starting observation now :eyes: will update at +10m and +30m. if no issues, I'll trigger 50% ramp at ~19:15 UTC.
